promptLines: Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: individual Palari V2 ceramic character study

Primary request: Create exactly one original Palari named palari-068. Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence: a small crafted ceramic being whose single colored interior reveals its unique intelligence. It belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.
Selected design:
- identity: a wingback stone crescent with a broad trailing sweep and one burgundy side reveal
- silhouette: slender asymmetric crescent with a finished architectural sweep; a closed exterior wingback arc and broad counterbalancing tail, never an upward-facing cavity
- crown: closed asymmetric upward sweep with a continuous exterior cap; no upward-facing cavity, open rim, bowl, or sharp tip
- opening: exactly one controlled deep-burgundy side reveal following the inner crescent silhouette
- pose: exactly two rounded arms crossed calmly around the side reveal
- expression: quietly confident, conveyed only by calm half-lidded eyes
- exterior material: balanced warm medium-grey stoneware, clearly grey rather than brown
- characteristic color: deep burgundy, #6E202C
Family invariants:
- exactly one complete isolated figure with a stable continuous ceramic base, full body visible
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue: deep burgundy only, limited to the recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark; no other chromatic accents
- exactly one dominant architecturally intentional side reveal; no unrelated holes except the seed mark
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, burgundy iris accents, and tiny catchlights; no mouth
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hands or fingers, crossed as simple overlapping tubes
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy

- one compact six-aperture Palari seed mark on the lower torso, with exactly six circular recesses: four visibly larger circles at the four corners of a compact rectangle plus two visibly smaller circles centered vertically between the corner pairs; the two middle-row circles must be clearly smaller than all four corner circles, reading as a deliberate seed symbol, not a grille
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges
- overall body height at least 2.4 times visible face height
- the crescent exterior remains closed, stable, and legless; the upper sweep is bluntly rounded
Scene/backdrop: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.
Style/medium: refined tactile 3D ceramic product render, adult collectible design, restrained and architectural rather than cute or chibi.

Composition/framing: direct 1:1 square; eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; centered; complete full figure visible; occupies about 76 percent of image height with comfortable padding.
Lighting/mood: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow; preserve readable ceramic form and inner depth without neon glow.

Avoid: simple horizontal bowl or cup rim, upward-facing cavity, open crescent rim, thin or sharp crescent tips, fingers, thumbs, palms, fingernails, realistic hands, conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, human skin, hair, clothing, jewelry, demographic costume shorthand, multiple characteristic colors, rainbow effects, neon glow, robot joints, screens, wires, exposed machinery, appliance details, random holes, more than one dominant opening, cracks, chips, broken rims, dirt, antique distressing, cups, mugs, vases, planters, lamps, speakers, household appliances, generic mascot smile, mouth, chibi proportions, horror, vacant doll eyes, circular aperture surrounding the face, text, labels, numbers, logos, watermark, extra characters, duplicate figure.

3. #6E202C deep burgundy for one continuous side reveal plus minimal iris/seed accents.

Style: Flat-first vector-friendly geometry with subtle continuous-gradient micro-volume. One uninterrupted low-frequency diffuse gradient per large IP color region, shared upper-left-to-lower-right light direction, each transition spanning at least 50% of the dominant form. Total lightness variation <= 0.08; hue drift <= 3 degrees; chroma drift <= 0.015. Modeling visible at full size but nearly disappearing at 32 x 32.
